title: Oil Fried Slovakian Dough Dumplings
description: A sweet and chewy Slovakian dish made with beer, perfect for a post-workout snack, featuring a gluten-free friendly option. This treat is deep-fried to a golden brown and served warm.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add the beer and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees.
Once the oil is hot, use a spoon to drop small balls of dough into the oil.
Fry the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side until they are golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the dumplings with powdered sugar and cinnamon.
Serve the dumplings warm and enjoy.
